comment: HH_260906 - Publish measured anchor accounting without changing datasets, history semantics or future policy.
publication_notice: Compact metadata view of the private route-and-warmup review, rechecked against source bytes and train/val frame metadata. No private absolute paths, sample payloads, camera pixels, or proposed route assignments are published.

method.join: Join each train/val prepared source_sample_id final CARLA frame number to same-source camera_frames.jsonl frame and capture_phase; verify samples.jsonl against episode.json and native manifest/camera-frame bytes against collection_config.json source_hashes.
method.history_count: Use the current plus previous nine sequence indices within the same episode, as Common10TorchDataset._ego_history does. Count warmup history slots without loading camera pixels or running a model.
method.historic_v2_check: All three original v2 samples.jsonl files are byte-identical to their v3 counterparts; those matching hashes are recorded in historical_v2_sample_identity.
method.limitation: This is a source/metadata audit performed by read-only inspection, not a new committed standalone audit runner or proof of model-error causation.

history_contract.stationary_tail_role: Native future-label context; not an optimizer/evaluation anchor.

explicit_release_contract.metadata_role: Timestamps and sequence indices support causal lookup; they are not a release-countdown input tensor.
explicit_release_contract.uncertainty: History masks, settling state, routes and camera-visible scene changes may supply correlated cues. No pixel or full-input equivalence analysis was performed; neither complete departure-intent unobservability nor causation of model errors is established.

prospective_history_only_warmup_policy.applies_to: A newly versioned and predeclared corpus/loader contract only; do not filter or rewrite the existing v3 or historical evaluations.
prospective_history_only_warmup_policy.proposal: Keep native warmup images/states and source identity for sensor settling and causal history, but exclude externally scheduled warmup anchors from future optimization and comparable new development metrics.
prospective_history_only_warmup_policy.implementation_dependency: Separate optimizer/evaluation anchor indices from the full per-episode causal history store. Current Common10TorchDataset._ego_history looks up history only within self.examples, so simply dropping warmup examples loses the first nine driving histories and is not a correct implementation.
prospective_history_only_warmup_policy.retained_labels: Retain every valid driving-phase stop/traffic wait and natural route-end target. Do not globally drop all zero-speed samples, clamp targets, or erase poor-quality evidence.
prospective_history_only_warmup_policy.onset_contract: Freeze an explicit external engagement boundary for collection/runtime ownership, or an explicitly model-observable departure-intent input with a new ABI if required. Do not train a countdown proxy silently or pretend this proposal adds a release cue.
prospective_history_only_warmup_policy.evaluation_dependency: Freeze full train/val definitions and expected denominators before new training; preserve the old337-anchor validation as a labelled legacy reference. New policy changes denominators and is not directly the same evaluation.
prospective_history_only_warmup_policy.accounting_only_if_applied_to_old_v3: Removing only the105/35 warmup anchors would leave1042train/302val anchors, but no such mutation or filtered evaluation was performed.

historical_document_correction.correction: Warmup anchors were included (v2 train70/613 and val35/337); only the65 stationary-tail anchors per episode were excluded. Historical data, metrics and denominators remain unchanged.
